recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If the resource diagram needs updating, handle it as generated-artifact maintenance rather than as a FHIR-46969 conformance source correction.
issue_request: FHIR-46969 was an Applied OO R6 change request reporting a missing value set binding on DeviceAssociation.category. Its Persuasive resolution directed completion as noted in FHIR-44840, with an application comment that .relationship was applied as per FHIR-44840.
initial_application: No FHIR-46969-tagged source commit was found. The relevant application is the FHIR-44840 change family, especially 743a304f21, which renamed DeviceAssociation.category to DeviceAssociation.relationship, added the DeviceAssociationRelationship extensible binding, created the relationship value set/code system, and added the relationship search parameter; cce271e159 and 3cf635fa2b made follow-up terminology and narrative updates.
additional_context: FHIR-44840 explicitly required the category-to-relationship rename and an extensible relationship value set including owner, custodian, patient, and operator. source/fhir.ini lists DeviceAssociation as active and records category removed and relationship added for R5-to-R6 migration. OO 2025-03-03 HCP minutes state FHIR-46969 was being addressed as part of FHIR-44840, and Zulip searches found no conflicting thread. The remaining DeviceAssociation.category hits are migration/history/narrative release-note context or the checked-in SVG diagram.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/deviceassociation/structuredefinition-DeviceAssociation.xml already defines DeviceAssociation.relationship with an extensible binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/deviceassociation-relationship. The only stale-looking category artifact is source/deviceassociation/deviceassociation.svg, and changing only that generated-looking diagram is outside the run's source-edit threshold.
